verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Color-coded overlay lines matching the p4 legend are traced consistently: red (DC cable, p13) from roof down to a wall 'hole'; purple (AC cable) and dark/light green (DC/AC earthing) connect the 'Inverter and its accessories', 'Battery' and 'UPS point' markers (p14) to further 'hole' markers; orange (LA cable, p15) runs down a building corner to the 'LA Pit' (p18); light green (AC earthing) continues down the façade (p16) to the 'AC Earth Pit' (p18); purple (AC cable) also links 'Main meter' to 'Solar meter' (p17). Each color's path starts and ends at a logical marker with no mismatched color hand-offs.
verdicts.rationale: The routing is logically continuous per the legend's color coding with no orphan-colored segments, but these are planned-route annotations overlaid on an under-construction site (no cables, conduit, or cable-ties are actually installed yet), so physical continuity and clipping/conduit cannot be verified from photos alone.
